### How to Take Them

- **Sip slowly:** Take small, frequent sips of 8–16 fl oz (or 250–500 mL) rather than chugging, especially if your stomach feels unsettled.
- **Skip straws if nauseous:** Drinking from a cup without a straw can reduce swallowed air that worsens nausea.
- **Pair with rest and bland food:** Combine fluids with sleep and light foods like toast, crackers, bananas, or eggs as your stomach allows, and avoid acetaminophen (Tylenol) after drinking due to liver strain.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1xfGfKtf2wKVFgm9yn8SPIskeV1eRvQMwjpNQX4tcjtS6dWayMVNvE8fRPnFEx9qjIxEjZwi0Aji3saOQJoaOZwUR8CJuip1F1LNTDa2gTEUrXZFyl6I5w3B07_Iaqm84OOvzCpgn6yJ5KMXU_y_hH06NGD-OilosZLVwns0mSLHo6DV5w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF18PGHbgr8onzQ0l4qNFplt4ec9RHpb8QBjwMKCuzq3jqo69J5c7tVVWTF-SixQiEDUe2VMAvUW5oMlyjrG-zD1u__1qTvSHh_wiV6JM8FvnH_6yArwbk8vwCLJ-yNWp4KdM2GJtn9YPAhEOGfqLyZFi6PhIA8QwHyNEoDYwXkF4LHKL6eg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXUtIEpVMTf0UZ89ixO5YUQYIY4nM1R2pCIqJpYUIsSm-6oAvyAbRszvPkvE8kY_K-F2a8qnADppcOV_RjErxhxgUTnFjfiX5t85UKcgkiCjr4ncpIZE9pdBSXbJKwgR08PywpXUpc)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXPiY7UIsvXjKm_f1IR4UG7L2iNj1OeuYwT3RPQkfpJ5fKBACESmnLa3erZQpgW8xGoi2qRsEXhZcpOiXPnUH1_C52bOx_Maf2O7opkqQvylS5Tp8ndAz24NhmtL_IyYs-FcoqcwS7tA)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXipH7YOa9QWfyaxfF93YMEFQ4ayiZtyY_wPMcr_ugozjdkg7be4Vmcl6SUT3VHg9E8Ik_J3qCnxwHPU2_ntXN1LQoMxdxMcS6SegpFrSX_IkhedVbZ2Q8xuRBLePelbeHAS6QH-Q)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX0r1xPGjGqp_rd1HhUMgzP5-7CDSLPGuY03-OE4JHU6iVhh2Kt40h1kZtDRgtF7i8V6w0k7xZKkzKB1H86f_pvhlZHsppO52ukiPz8GQfVGjp7v9FEzqqPSRJr4t55oZMSM3MHj0ZQw)
